meta.name: ai-provider-cohere-sdk
meta.description: Official Cohere TypeScript SDK patterns -- CohereClientV2, chat, embeddings, rerank, RAG with citations, tool use, streaming, and model selection

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 TypeScript 调用 Cohere 的聊天、嵌入、重排序等 AI 能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 TypeScript 开发需要集成 Cohere 大模型的应用
copy.tagline_en: Call Cohere's chat, embeddings, rerank and more with TypeScript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building TypeScript apps that need to integrate Cohere's AI models

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你用 Cohere 的 AI 模型做聊天、搜索、文档排序和带引用的问答。它会调用 Cohere 的 API 来生成回复、计算文本相似度或给搜索结果打分。
howto.when: 当你提到 Cohere、cohere-ai、CohereClientV2 等关键词，或要求使用 Cohere 的 Command 模型、嵌入、重排序、RAG 或工具调用时触发。

say.text: 用 Cohere 嵌入计算这两句话的相似度。
say.note: Claude 会调用 embed 接口并返回向量。

say.text: 用 Cohere 重排序，把最相关的文档排前面。
say.note: Claude 会调用 rerank 接口返回排序结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Cohere's AI models for chat, search, document ranking, and Q&A with citations. It calls Cohere's API to generate responses, compute text similarity, or score search results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Cohere, cohere-ai, CohereClientV2, or ask to use Cohere's Command models, embeddings, rerank, RAG, or tool use.

say_en.text: Use Cohere's Command-A model to answer: What is TypeScript?
say_en.note: Claude will call Cohere's chat endpoint.

say_en.text: Use Cohere embeddings to compute similarity between these two sentences.
say_en.note: Claude will call the embed endpoint and return vectors.

say_en.text: Use Cohere rerank to put the most relevant documents first.
say_en.note: Claude will call the rerank endpoint and return sorted results.
